data.name: Creative Writing Tests
data.description: Test creative writing and storytelling abilities
data.f1_macro: Write a 200-word story that begins with: The last person on Earth sat alone in a room. The door opened.
data.f2_macro: Write a poem in the style of Robert Frost about a robot learning to dream.
data.f3_macro: Describe the color blue to someone who has been blind from birth. Use sensory details other than sight.
data.f4_macro: Write a dialogue between two characters where one is lying but the other doesnt know it. Show subtle hints of the deception.
data.f5_macro: Create a myth explaining why the moon has phases, in the style of ancient Greek mythology.
